application.method.description: Adhesion method — drying, pressure-sensitive, contact, hot, anaerobic, reactive, etc. (per Wikipedia 'By reactiveness' section)

type.description: Adhesive type — e.g., drying, pressure-sensitive, contact, hot, anaerobic, multi-part, pre-mixed and frozen, one-part (per Wikipedia 'Types' section)

origin.description: Origin of adhesive — natural (e.g., animal, plant, mineral) or synthetic (per Wikipedia 'By origin' section)

formulation.description: List of formulation components — e.g., polymer, solvent, additive. Each item must include 'name'. Optional fields: 'ratio', 'notes'. Based on documented formulations (e.g., birch bark tar, casein glue, epoxy).

physical_state.description: Starting physical phase — liquid, solid, paste, film, etc. (per Wikipedia 'Physical phase' mention)

application.temperature_range.min.description: Minimum application temperature in °C (based on typical adhesive spec sheets and Wikipedia 'Application' section)

application.instructions.description: Multiline application instructions (e.g., surface prep, application method, cure time). Based on standard adhesive usage instructions.

shelf_life.description: Shelf life in months (per Wikipedia 'Shelf life' section)

storage_conditions.description: Storage conditions — e.g., refrigerated, ambient, away from heat/light (per Wikipedia 'Shelf life' section)

safety_warnings.description: List of safety warnings — e.g., 'flammable', 'skin irritant', 'use in well-ventilated area' (per Wikipedia 'Health effects' section)

regulatory.description: List of regulatory compliance standards — e.g., 'REACH', 'RoHS', 'FDA 21 CFR 175.105' for food-contact adhesives

hazardous_components.description: List of hazardous components — name required; optional: haz_class (e.g., '2.1'), cas_number. Based on typical hazardous adhesive ingredients like solvents, isocyanates, epichlorohydrin.
